title: B.Sc / M.Sc Chemistry | KSS KPGU
content: t of Chemistry at Krishna School of Science, Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), offers B.Sc. (Hons.) with Research in Chemistry, M.Sc. Organic Chemistry under NEP-2020, and Ph.D. programs in Chemistry. The department is equipped with modern laboratories and classroom infrastructure for robust teaching-learning experiences. 02 Faculty members bring diverse teaching and research backgrounds from leading national and international institutions.
